text:
pat: customer reported double charge after stream truncate + reconnect. billing UI shows provisional then confirmed for overlapping tokens.

mei: can you paste ids? region?

pat: req=req-772 sess=s-7c2 eu-central. runtime logged truncated_prefix=90, client retried, resume replayed 90 tokens.

ash: quick logs: 
2026-03-20T11:01:10Z router: provisional sess=s-7c2 tokens=300
2026-03-20T11:01:14Z runtime: truncate emitted_prefix=90
2026-03-20T11:01:18Z router: resume sess=s-7c2 resume_prefix=90
2026-03-20T11:01:19Z ledger: provisional_insert sess=s-7c2 tokens=90 prov_id=pr-9a
2026-03-20T11:01:21Z ledger: confirm_insert sess=s-7c2 tokens=90

ash: root cause: resume path creates new provisional/confirm without tombstoning original provisional. no stable prefix id propagated.

jon: options: (A) propagate a prefix_prov_id on first emission and upsert confirm by prov_id; (B) tombstone old provisional on handoff. A seems safer.

mei: short-term console mitigation: collapse rows that share session+overlapping range within 48h and show "suspected merge" with expand for raw rows.

pat: telemetry: add billing.prov_upsert_attempts and billing.duplicate_confirm_alerts. also dashboard panel provisional_vs_confirm_delta.

ash: rollout plan: feature-flag prov_id in router, ledger upsert behind flag, console merge read-side optional. enable in canary, watch duplicate_confirm_alerts.

jon: tests: ledger.upsert_by_prov_id unit tests, integration sim for concurrent handoff + resume. add small chaos scenario.

billing-bot: created ticket BILL-2026-145 and alert rule billing.duplicate_confirm > 2/min.

pat: i'll open the router PR and a short proto for prov_id format (sha256(req_id + prefix_start + salt)). mei take console. ash owns ledger. jon recon & tests.

mei: will mock UX and add expand link to audit rows. thanks.

pat: will paste any other sessions if support finds them.
